Build usable solutions.

summary.zh: 我是注音，碩士畢業，目前尋找軟體開發、資訊系統與 MIS 相關工作。從 AI 數學解題、數位教育遊戲到 Unity 互動情境，我關注如何把技術用在真實的學習與使用需求中。
summary.en: I’m Zhuyin, a master’s graduate seeking opportunities in software development, information systems, and MIS. My projects span AI-assisted mathematics problem solving, digital educational games, and interactive Unity environments, with a focus on practical learning and user needs.

about.zh:
你可以叫我注音。我已完成國立中央大學網路學習科技研究所碩士學業，目前尋找軟體開發、資訊系統與 MIS 相關工作。大學就讀亞洲大學行動商務與多媒體應用學系，雙主修資訊工程學系，也曾選修心理學課程。

我喜歡把問題做成可以操作的工具：以 Unity 與 C# 開發數位教育遊戲、以 Python 與 PyTorch 參與農作物影像辨識競賽，也透過 PHP、MySQL、HTML 與 CSS 學習網頁建置。碩士論文專案則讓學生以圖畫和文字與 AI 互動，進行數學問題解決。

從高中經營部落格到兒童程式營隊，我持續透過實作、教學與記錄整理自己的學習。自主學習、願意嘗試，以及從使用者角度思考，是我在不同專案中累積的工作方式。
about.en:
I go by Zhuyin. I have completed my master’s studies at National Central University’s Graduate Institute of Network Learning Technology and am seeking software development, information systems, and MIS roles. At Asia University, I majored in M-Commerce and Multimedia Application with a second major in Computer Science and Information Engineering, and also took psychology courses.

I enjoy turning problems into working tools: educational games with Unity and C#, crop image classification with Python and PyTorch, and web development using PHP, MySQL, HTML, and CSS. My master’s thesis project lets students interact with AI through drawings and text to solve mathematics problems.

From blogging in high school to assisting at children’s programming camps, I learn through building, teaching, and documenting. Independent learning, willingness to try, and attention to users shape how I approach projects.

interests.zh: 平時會閱讀科技資訊，關注手機、穿戴裝置與電腦硬體等產品發展；休閒喜歡旅遊、象棋、黑白棋、單車、羽球與保齡球。高中畢業後曾以單車環島，並在部落格記錄沿途故事；參加研討會時也會安排認識當地，持續探索不同地方。也曾陪伴學生以單車完成花蓮到臺東的路程，參與兒童營隊與教會陪讀。
interests.en: I follow technology news, especially new phones, wearables, and computer hardware. Outside work, I enjoy travelling, chess, Reversi, cycling, badminton, and bowling. After high school, I cycled around Taiwan and documented the journey on my blog; when attending conferences, I also make time to explore the host city. I have also accompanied students cycling from Hualien to Taitung and taken part in children’s camps and church reading activities.
